title: Shop settings

profile.title: Legal and financing profile
profile.description: Shop legal identifiers and installment financing controls.
profile.consumerStatusHelp: Owner-entered information only. EcoFin does not determine legal eligibility.
profile.installmentsHelp: Turning this off blocks new contracts. Existing contracts can still be serviced.

description: The rules your shop runs by. The system reads them on every sale, receipt and installment contract.
nothingChanged: Nothing to save on this tab.

general.name: Shop name
general.currencyHelp: EcoFin sells in Egyptian pounds only.
general.logoUploaded: Logo uploaded. Save to use it.

tax.pricesIncludeVatHelp: On: the price on the shelf already includes VAT. Off: VAT is added at checkout.
tax.defaultTaxClass: Default tax class for new products
tax.noTaxClasses: No tax classes yet. They are added with the VAT engine.
tax.accountant: VAT rules to confirm with your accountant
tax.accountantHelp: These defaults follow common practice. Change them if your accountant says otherwise.
tax.depositTiming: When an order deposit is taxed

sales.discountCapsHelp: The owner has no limit. A role left at 0 can't give a discount without approval.
sales.allowNegativeBank: Allow bank accounts to go below zero
sales.allowNegativeBankHelp: Safes, drawers and wallets never go below zero.

credit.minScore: Minimum credit score to buy on installments
credit.limitMultipleHelp: Leave empty to set each customer's limit by hand.
credit.weightsHelp: How much each factor counts. The total must be 100.

legal.referralDays: Days overdue before a contract goes to legal
legal.banDays: Ban period for a defaulted customer (days)

inventory.globalMinStockHelp: Used for products that have no minimum of their own.

policy.intro: Each change creates a new version. Contracts already signed keep the version they were made with.
policy.unchanged: These are the current terms; no new version was made.

rules.installment_per_day_of_month: One installment per day of the month so far

policy.amountTiersHelp: A sale above the last amount uses the maximum months.
policy.markupHelp: The last row must cover the maximum months.
policy.noLateFees: No late fees are ever charged (Islamic finance): a late customer never owes more because of the delay. Late installments are followed up on the Overdue page.
policy.graceHelp: An installment counts as late only after its due date plus these days.

earlyRules.percent_of_future_profit: Discount a percent of future profit

policy.guarantorsCountHelp: How many guarantors a contract above that amount needs (1 to 3). Available once an amount is set.

errors.SETTINGS_INVALID: One of the values isn't allowed. Check the fields on this tab.
errors.POLICY_INVALID: These terms don't fit together. Check the tiers and the per-frequency rules.
errors.TAX_CLASS_NOT_FOUND: That tax class no longer exists.
errors.FILE_NOT_FOUND: The logo file wasn't found. Upload it again.
errors.INSTALLMENTS_DISABLED: New installment contracts are disabled for this shop.
errors.weightsSum: The weights must add up to 100.

taxClasses.title: Tax classes
taxClasses.description: Each product has a class. A new rate applies to new documents only; issued receipts keep theirs.
taxClasses.name: Name
taxClasses.rateHelp: A new rate applies to new documents only.
taxClasses.nameTaken: A tax class with this name already exists.
taxClasses.inUse: This class is in use (default class, delivery fees or active products), so it can't be archived.
